1: import {readFileSync} from "node:fs";
2: const read = p => JSON.parse(readFileSync(p));
3: const plan = read("shift-plan.json"), log = read("operations/cold-cycle.json");
4: const limits = log.samples.map(s => (s.acMeterEndKwh-s.acMeterStartKwh)*60/s.minutes);
5: const actual = limits.map((k,i)=>Math.min(k,plan.acKw[i]));
6: console.log(JSON.stringify({run:log.run,time:log.time,limits,actual,withinLimits:plan.acKw.every((k,i)=>k<=limits[i]),departureKwh:[72+.45*(actual[0]+actual[1]),76+.45*(actual[2]+actual[3])]}));
